summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge by analyzing Soony's confidential launch data and building a product (ask-soony) that rechecks the launch plan against documents on every new drop, flags contradictions with sources, and acts through supplier emails and approvals.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition and game cards miss Sunday despite an 'all ok' plan, then built a polling/versioned-store pipeline, a routines/automation backend, a verifier shortfall fix (34,800 to 6,800 game cards), and a calm phone-first 'Today' UI, all committed locally. Briefing pages, interview docs and a design canvas were also created.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path}, /archive.zip); no webhooks or notifications. Files change without warning and existing files are replaced under the same name, so polling must compare SHA-256 checksums, not just filenames.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, design, state); .env is gitignored and .env.example is committed with an empty SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN.
Team workflow is in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; tasks are claimed with a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md. Work is on branch jonas/alert-platform with PR #5 open into main.
The Entire hook only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; read-only sessions log 'no files modified, skipping checkpoint'.

Data traps: SAP receipt WZ-261116-473 books 80,000 art books vs 8,000 real; 5,600 failed-inspection statues booked unrestricted; lid-magnet shortage is a false alarm (PackRight fits them); sleeve revision B vs C conflict; Boise ships EXW not DDP; 78,000 pins have no PO.

Verifier counts inbound as 'arriving' only when its ETA is on or before launch, it is not cancelled or already received, and the supplier shipping document confirms the quantity; an unread shipping document is treated conservatively as not counted.
The image recognizer put the part number in the `item` field with an empty `material_id`, so the short shipment was not linked until a part-number fallback was added in line mapping.

code.finding: Each part now carries `arriving` and `not_counted` lists; gap = needed - usable - arriving. Hwaseong's 20,000 balance (Tue 24 Nov) is never counted.
Holds all Today-screen wording, built from card fields with nothing hardcoded; the forToday logic had to be fixed to stop borrowing another part's stop time.
Wide routine diagram restructured into When/Then/Always lanes that wrap; the narrow vertical view is unchanged.
Routines support four triggers (decisions, waiting, shipments, replies), steps chase/call/ask_status, trust modes ask/tell/quiet, undo with honest refusal reasons, and per-step 'when' conditions.

workflow: Delegating independent work (data cross-checks, verifier fix, routines backend, design, front-end rebuild) to parallel subagents, each given disjoint files, avoided edit conflicts.
Publishing Claude artifact canvases requires the project files inside the project folder; using a gitignored data/design/ keeps confidential content out of git.
Screenshots with mocked /api/state and POSTs let UI be verified without sending real supplier emails.
Paid or outward-facing actions (OpenAI recognizer run, pushing commits, emailing suppliers) were gated on explicit user approval.

friction: The SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN was empty at the start, blocking data access until the user supplied it.
Five new data files landed within 37 minutes without announcement, invalidating the first findings and the briefing page, which still shows the 14:00 state.
The dashboard still showed 34,800 game cards short until a paid recognizer reading of the Hwaseong advice existed locally.
Standard still displays 'runs out Sat 22:00' because a genuine card (collect 350,000 card cases from the port) limits it, which looks drastic for a demo.
The first design canvas directions were judged far too cluttered, forcing a redo toward a minimal Sunday flow.
A Teams header with emoji spanned multiple lines and escaped the first scripted replacement.
Whether portal data and supplier replies differ per team is unknown and unanswered by the materials.
A login password pasted into chat is now in Discord history.
